title: Northern Door County Boat Rental
specs: High horsepower engines (115 and 150 HP) for extra fun on the water
Water sports equipment available including tubes, wakeboards, water skis, lily pads
Boating license may be required for rentals (not for paddleboards)
Anyone born after January 1, 1989 must have a boater's safety license to operate a boat
Driver(s) must sign paperwork ahead of time
Boats seat up to 12 (Cruiser) or 16 (Coastal) guests

blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats or paddle boards to explore the scenic coastlines of Door County including Sister Bay, Fish Creek, and Gills Rock. Boats come equipped with safety gear and water sports accessories. Dogs are allowed on boats with a towel or blanket to protect seats.
extraNote: No refunds; cancellations with 48+ hours notice receive 100% credit for future use · No shows or cancellations within 48 hours are charged full reservation cost · No cancellations allowed for less than ideal weather; operator may cancel for unsafe conditions with full refund · Fuel is not included; boats leave with full tank and are refueled on return, guest pays for fuel used · Yacht Works Marina in Northern Sister Bay; Fish Creek location downtown Fish Creek; Gills Rock location at the marina
